import random

content = note['content']

quotes = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # remove leading "- "
        quote_part = line[2:]
        # split on " by " to get quote and author
        if ' by ' in quote_part:
            quote_text = quote_part.split(' by ')[0].strip()
        else:
            quote_text = quote_part.strip()
        quotes.append(quote_text)

random_quote = random.choice(quotes)
print(random_quote)
